title: Beyond GDP: New Framework for Measuring Wellbeing and Sustainability
discussion_signal: The post interprets the UN framework as a practical shift toward measuring current wellbeing, equity and inclusion, and sustainability and resilience alongside foundational principles. The discussion treats measurement as political: what is counted shapes what institutions recognize and act on, while also presenting the dashboard as a complement to rather than a simple replacement for GDP.
linked_research_question: How do alternative measures of progress change collective judgments about fairness, resilience, and legitimate policy priorities?
limits: Individual professional interpretation of a UN framework
LinkedIn engagement is not a representative deliberative sample
The post does not test whether alternative indicators change policy decisions
